name: discover_capabilities
description: List installed tools, native render capabilities, examples and unsupported requests.

name: get_context
description: Retrieve bounded animation recipes and relevant example scenes; no model calls.

name: load_example
description: Create a project from an original editable example.

name: create_project
description: Create an immutable revision-zero project from a validated typed 2D scene.

name: inspect_project
description: Inspect source and evaluated state at a frame.

name: validate_proposal
description: Validate a new scene or proposed transaction without publishing changes.

name: apply_revision
description: Atomically apply named-ID operations. Stale revisions and semantic conflicts fail without mutation.

name: undo
description: Restore an earlier snapshot as a new revision.

name: preview
description: Render a 640x360 native preview, temporal contact sheet, state trace and editable source. Bounded synchronous job; existing valid frames resume.

name: inspect_artifact
description: Inspect a verified job and optional frame image for a vision-capable host.

name: record_review
description: Record explicit visual-review evidence for this project revision. Notes do not constitute independent proof of quality.

name: render_final
description: Export 1280x720 video from the currently accepted reviewed revision. All pixels are rendered by code.

name: start_workflow
description: Start durable workflow budget/memory. Use workflow_step to enforce per-session tool and preview limits.

name: workflow_step
description: Call one installed production tool inside a bounded recorded workflow; tool errors consume call budget.

name: finish_workflow
description: Finish with explicit evidence and outstanding limitations, rather than assuming a valid scene is a good video.
